description: Laravel repo-owned local contract that mirrors the protected CI architecture and full test gates through the canonical local Docker runtime.

command: if ! docker compose ps --status running --services | grep -Fxq app; then echo "INFO: reconciling local Docker runtime for Laravel architecture gate..."; COMPOSE_PROFILES=local-db docker compose down --remove-orphans >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; COMPOSE_PROFILES=local-db docker compose up -d app worker scheduler nginx; fi && docker compose exec -T app composer run architecture:guardrails
entries.description: Run the Laravel architecture guardrails inside the canonical local app container, bootstrapping the local Docker runtime first when needed.
Run the Laravel full test suite through the canonical local-safe Docker runner.
